title: [BodyHealthAddon] SkriptAddon
body:
**This is a [BodyHealth](https://modrinth.com/plugin/bodyhealth) addon, not a standalone plugin!**
It needs to go in `plugins/BodyHealth/addons/`, not `plugins/`! This addon relays BodyHealth's API to [Skript](https://modrinth.com/plugin/skript), allowing you to control it without any Java knowledge. ⤷ [Learn how to use this addon to manage BodyHealth with Skript](https://github.com/Mitality/SkriptAddon/blob/main/documentation.md)
